title: Build your sales team's internal tools with coding agents
summary: Zipchat's Luca Borreani says he built the company's internal tools with Lovable and Claude Code, from pitch decks to conference-return tracking, and the team now runs on them.
agent_role: The coding agents wrote the internal apps; the founder decided what to build around how the company works.
outcome: Author reports the tools need almost no maintenance, cost little and have given a huge return.
what_they_did: Over a year, Zipchat's founder used Lovable and Claude Code to build the company's internal tools. They include a one-minute custom sales deck maker, prospect store research, competitor tracking and a dashboard showing demos and revenue from each conference. He also built spending categorization, a shareholder dashboard, a partner portal and an event check-in system.
how_it_went: He says the team spends its day in these tools, with almost no maintenance and tiny cost. He can see in 10 seconds which events brought the most demos and revenue.
worth_knowing: He would not rebuild everything; the tools fit how Zipchat works and would likely be worth nothing to another company.
prompt: Help me build a simple internal tool for my team: [describe the task, e.g. track which conferences led to sales meetings]. Ask me what data we have ([spreadsheet / CRM export]) and how we work today. Then propose a short plan and screens, and wait for my approval before writing code. Build it step by step and show me each working piece.

curation.rationale: A concrete list of business tools a founder built with coding agents and his team uses daily, but there are no build details, numbers or demos.
